projectNote: Project name — appears in report headers and the Telegram bot help.
langNote: Report and CLI language: en or ru. Switching later renames a few finding subjects — re-run --accept afterwards.

figma.changeLogNodeNote: Optional: node-id of the change-log section where the agent writes review cards.

prototypesRootNote: Where the markup lives: a prototypes/ folder next to the bot (single-repo mode) or an absolute path on disk (bot-beside-a-folder mode).
prototypesNote: One entry per markup folder. tier: current — fully checked; legacy — raw values only, no demands to build out states. theme — which variable mode to compare values against (the bot re-verifies against facts). accent — if your DS has accent modes; empty otherwise.
watchlistNote: DS component names whose absence from the code is worth reporting. Empty — only components actually used are checked.
componentMapNote: CSS class → DS component name, for code without link comments: {".btn": "Button", ".chip": "Chip"}.
stateMapNote: DS state → selectors that count as its implementation. Defaults cover common conventions; extend with your own classes.
stateMapByComponentNote: Overrides for words that mean different things: on Button "Active" is a press, on Tab — the selected tab. See examples/config-r4s.json.
statesProvidedByWrapperNote: States living on a wrapper rather than the component itself (.is-invalid on .field) — searched across the whole prototype.
outOfScopeNote: Selectors of foreign chrome (platform widgets, an embedded portal) — counted separately, never treated as DS drift.
foreignVariablePrefixesNote: Variable prefixes of foreign kits that arrived with copied components: {"Core/": "some foreign kit"}.
knownGapsNote: What the mockups are known to lack — so the bot does not report it as an error.
failOnNote: Run failure threshold: new | high | medium | low | never.
